scripts.app:host: pnpm -C apps/api manifest && docker compose up -d postgres && docker compose stop web worker && set -a && . ./.env && set +a && concurrently -k -n worker,web -c blue,green "pnpm -C apps/worker start" "pnpm -C apps/web dev"
scripts.dev: pnpm -C apps/api manifest && pnpm -C apps/web dev
scripts.build: pnpm -C apps/api manifest:check && pnpm -C apps/web build
scripts.lint: oxlint --type-aware --report-unused-disable-directives && knip --no-config-hints && pnpm format:check && pnpm -C apps/web lint && pnpm check:catalog
scripts.check:catalog: pnpm -C apps/api manifest:check && pnpm -C apps/cli map:check
